packageRules.description: Angular majors go through the update-angular skill: ng update's migrations across the packages and ~100 examples, the published peer ranges, and the docs, none of which a version bump does. Minors and patches still come through.

Architect is versioned 0.MMmm.p (Angular 22.2 is 0.2202), so semver calls its move to the next Angular major (0.2300) a minor, and the rule above doesn't catch it. The update-angular skill moves this bound up with each major.
Each Angular release accepts only some TypeScript minors (its typescript peer range), so a TypeScript minor on its own fails the install. The update-angular skill moves TypeScript with Angular.

@types/node's major is the Node version it types, and the packages support Node 22.12 and later (engines), so a newer major lets the type check pass code using an API Node 22 lacks. Majors move by hand.

The examples and packages/ui use Tailwind 3 on purpose: @lynx-js/tailwind-preset supports only Tailwind 3 (peer ^3.4.0), and with Tailwind 4 the build skips their tailwind.config.ts and they render unstyled though the build passes. examples/tailwind-4 covers Tailwind 4. Majors move by hand.

The rsbuild plugin hands rspack plugins a Compiler from @lynx-js/rspeedy, which pins an exact @rsbuild/core and so an @rspack/core minor (2.2 in rspeedy 0.18.6). The plugin types that Compiler with its own @rspack/core, so a newer minor installs a second copy and its declaration build fails on the two Compiler types (#506). Move it by hand when rspeedy moves. @rsbuild/core minors build fine (#505).
Each @ng-native package peers on the others at its exact version, so one moved alone fails the install (ERESOLVE). They move together.
